label: L-02
title: The post-broadcast `:preview` 'verification' re-executes any outstanding step under prank instead of asserting it is already done, so a partial or diverged mainnet cutover verifies green
fingerprintVerified: sha256(fingerprintBasis) reproduces the stored ledger fingerprint byte-for-byte; copied verbatim from classified-findings.json.
description: The package.json doc key and the story both claim that after a broadcast, `:preview` "re-runs every assertion and smoke test against the live deployment", with every phase detecting "from on-chain state that it is done and skips". In fact every phase is `if (!done) do();`. Preview impersonates OWNER, so any step that did NOT land on mainnet is silently performed inside the simulation, and Phase 8 then asserts the simulated state. Nothing in preview mode, not even with a progress file loaded, requires that zero mutations were needed. The per-user loss bound is also evaluated only over `plan.migratable` from the same leg, which is empty after a broadcast, so the on-chain credits are never re-checked. This is the run-22 `ForgeLocalPassPrecedesBroadcast` family: all planning and assertions run in forge's local pass, and the batches are frozen there, before the Ledger session sends ~47 transactions with `--slow --skip-simulation`. A V1 `stake` that lands after the local pass but before the Phase-1 `pause()` transaction (cf. ledger c04da307336c on promotion-ready) is absent from every batch. Phase 7 then revokes V1's phUSD mint anyway, which bricks that user's `userMigrate` while their frozen pending is non-zero. The chained preview then migrates them in simulation and reports success.
impact: The operator's only automated outcome check can report a finished cutover while mainnet has V1 phUSD mint still live, V2 still paused, or a staker stranded on V1 behind a revoked mint. Remedies exist (owner re-grant plus re-run), but nothing surfaces the need for them. No direct loss is proven. Mainnet per-user loss stays bounded by the strategies' own minOut floors.
attackPath: 1. Broadcast: forge's local pass plans and freezes about 47 transactions, then the Ledger session sends them with --slow --skip-simulation.
2. Some step does not land, e.g. setMinter(V1,false) or v2.unpause(), or a V1 stake lands between the local pass and the Phase-1 pause tx and is absent from every frozen batch.
3. The operator runs :preview to verify; every phase is if(!done) do() under vm.startPrank(OWNER), so the missing step is performed in simulation.
4. Phase 8 asserts the simulated state and prints output byte-identical to a clean run (fork-verified: MASK_REVOKE and MASK_PAUSED_V2 both PASS).
recommendation: Unchanged from run-31, extended. When `isPreview` and the progress file has `deploymentStatus == completed`, run a verify-only pass BEFORE `vm.startPrank` that requires every phase's done-condition, including the V1 retirement triple (pauser==OWNER, !isRegistered, paused), instead of performing it. Revert `verify: step X not on chain` on any gap, and only then run the smoke tests.
originalRecommendation: Add a separate assert-only verifier (mirroring story-075's standalone VerifyPromotionReady.s.sol) or an explicit VERIFY_ONLY env-flag mode that never calls vm.startPrank/vm.startBroadcast and never mutates. Gate it on ON-CHAIN state, not on the progress file: do NOT key verify-only mode off progress-file deploymentStatus == completed, because progress files can be stamped completed during forge's local pass (ledger 1e8cc0dc58ba). In that mode every phase must require(alreadyDone, 'verify: step X not on chain') and never perform it. Live asserts must include: V1 phUSD mint revoked, V2 and Antimatter unpaused, V1 stakerCount/totalStaked per pool <= the straggler allow-list, V2 pauser == Pauser, and the Antimatter minter set. Re-check the per-user loss bound from on-chain receipts (V1 MigratedOut / V2 DepositedFor events, or persisted pre-migration principals) against V2 userInfo rather than the empty same-leg plan. Separately, assert that the set of V1 stakers at the Phase-1 pause block equals the frozen planning set, and fail loudly if a staker raced the window.
evidence: Fork @25978784 (fork-logs/h32-test_C*.log): test_C `MASK_REVOKE|preview run() PASSED although V1 phUSD mint was live on-chain`; test_C2 `MASK_PAUSED_V2|... V2 was paused on-chain`; NEW test_C3: after a full cutover, V1 unpaused, pauser set back to Pauser and re-registered, then `run()` -> `MASK_V1_RETIRE|preview run() PASSED although V1 was registered+unpaused on-chain`.
run32Observation: run-32 extension (884ccf8): story 083 added three more `if (!done) do();` steps (V1 setPauser(OWNER), Pauser.unregister(V1), V1 pause). test_C3_previewMasksMissingV1Retirement: after a full cutover, V1 unpaused, pauser set back to Pauser and re-registered, then preview run() -> `MASK_V1_RETIRE|preview run() PASSED although V1 was registered+unpaused on-chain`. test_C / test_C2 still PASS (masking reproduced). Surface widened; same root cause.
